topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: It's funny how things change. I’ve always seen Mr. Johnson fetching his mail in the same old patched coat, his garden a bit overgrown, like he's too busy or too tired to tend to it. But last week, his daughter had a lavish party, and the guests were driving up in shiny, expensive cars. Then, I noticed a sleek new boat parked in his backyard, hidden from the street view. Turns out, he's been sailing around the Caribbean all these years while we thought he was just an average Joe. Who would have thought? The more I think about it, the more little signs add up. Makes you wonder what else has been right under your nose.
